configurations.title: Cascading Curation
configurations.study_desc:
Level one curation at Horizon includes identification of the plant by an observer in the field using 

 7623  - plant that the organism was found on 

A curator will then use this table to fill additional information about which part of the plant was visited (flower, leaf, stem, etc.) and the plant interaction (nectaring / pollinating, feeding, etc.)

 21998 - location on plant
 21273 - plant interaction
configurations.field_name: plant that the organism was found on

configurations.study_desc:
Level two curation at Horizon displays any organism curated as having been found on a flower during level one.  This table allows further curation of the pollination and nectaring observations from Level one.  At this level, a curator will look for a clear image of a proboscis being used by a nectarer or body combing pollen on a pollinator.

 9603  - proboscis inserted
 11472 - body combing pollen
